en: <CLT=cltMIND>A ton of insect specimens are on display...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta used to look at these specimens with
such unbridled joy. I can't believe he's gone...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a bookcase here, full of books
related to insects.

<CLT=cltMIND>Some books are left open.
Was Gonta in the middle of reading them...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Wow...
That...is an extraordinary amount of bug cages.
